reason: Reproduced on home.task-reimbursement: after Enter on the row the panel takes focus on Close detail panel, and activating it removes expenseId from the URL and fades the panel out (opacity 0, inside aria-hidden) but leaves it in the DOM with focus still on its Close button, now at x 1466 on a 1440px viewport and hidden from the accessibility tree. The next Tab lands on an Approve button below the fold, so focus never returns to a visible control (shot:a11y/runs/2026-10-03-1525/shots/verify/verify-204/home.task-reimbursement-closed-focus.png). The Tasks row the finding names is gone after the open, because Enter navigates to Reimbursements, so the return target is the expense row there; the failure is the same. Keyboard users can keep tabbing from the wrong place, so it stays medium.
